chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abdullah, who said:
Al-Rida (peace be upon him) said to me: 'When you marry, marry a woman with large buttocks.'

key_terms.عَجَْاءَ: A woman with large buttocks (feminine singular accusative)

ai.seo_question: What does the term 'ajza' mean in the context of marriage in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) advises preferring a woman with 'ajza' (large buttocks), a physical trait in Shia fiqh interpreted as a sign of fertility and robustness for childbearing. This preference is rooted in the practical consideration of securing lineage and ensuring the mother's physical capacity to bear and nurse children, reflecting the broader Islamic emphasis on procreation within marriage.
